# DiagnosticsCollector

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Collects diagnostics during PDF generation. The Document owns one instance for the lifetime of a Save / SaveAsync / GenerateBytes call; subsystems push diagnostics into it instead of calling `Console.WriteLine` / `Debug.WriteLine` directly so the library never writes to a global sink the caller did not opt into.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new DiagnosticsCollector()
```

## Properties

- [`All`](#all): Every diagnostic collected so far, in the order it was added.
- [`Count`](#count): The number of diagnostics collected so far.
- [`HasErrors`](#haserrors): `true` when at least one error-severity diagnostic has been collected.
- [`HasWarnings`](#haswarnings): `true` when at least one warning-severity diagnostic has been collected.

## Methods

- [`Add`](#add): Adds a diagnostic to the collection.
- [`AddError`](#adderror): Adds an error-severity diagnostic with the given category, message, optional source and underlying exception.
- [`AddInfo`](#addinfo): Adds an informational diagnostic with the given category, message and optional source.
- [`AddWarning`](#addwarning): Adds a warning-severity diagnostic with the given category, message, optional source and underlying exception.
- [`Clear`](#clear): Removes every collected diagnostic.
- [`Print`](#print): Writes each collected diagnostic to `Error` / `Out` according to severity.

### `Add`

```csharp
void Add(Diagnostic d)
```

Adds a diagnostic to the collection. A `null` diagnostic is ignored.


### `Clear`

```csharp
void Clear()
```

### `Print`

```csharp
void Print()
```

Writes each collected diagnostic to `Error` / `Out` according to severity. This is a convenience for callers that just want the messages surfaced; library code never calls this implicitly.
